Team 2 — DevOps

End-to-End Deployment Pipeline

An automated DevOps workflow that provisions infrastructure, configures the server, containerizes a website, and deploys it — with minimal manual steps.

The CI/CD Pipeline (Jenkins)

When code is pushed to GitHub, Jenkins runs these five stages automatically:

1

Checkout

Pull the latest code from GitHub.

→
2

Build

Package the site into a Docker image.

→
3

Push to ECR

Store the image in AWS ECR.

→
4

Deploy

Run the container on EC2 (port 80).

→
5

Smoke Test

Confirm the site returns HTTP 200.

Tools & Services

Terraform

Infrastructure as Code — provisions the AWS EC2 instance.

Infra

Ansible

Configures the server: installs packages and clones the repo.

Config

Docker

Packages the website + nginx into a portable image.

Package

Amazon ECR

Private registry that stores the built Docker images.

Registry

Jenkins

Orchestrates the whole pipeline: build, push, deploy, test.

CI/CD

AWS EC2

The server that runs Jenkins and hosts the live website.
